SELECT 
    fished_date_doy,
    cls,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
    COUNT(*) as num_boats,
    ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 200

SELECT 
    fished_date_doy,
    cls,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
    COUNT(*) as num_boats,
    ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 AND fished_date_doy >= 60
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls

SELECT 
    fish_date_doy,
    cls,
    boat,
    COUNT(*) as landing_count
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 92 AND 105
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls, boat
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
    ts_doy,
    ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c)::numeric, 2) as avg_temp_c,
    ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c)::numeric, 2) as min_temp_c,
    ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c)::numeric, 2) as max_temp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 85
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10
